provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Bounty Hunter at Every Level

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（行业档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你职业档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用短句把你逐级送上能力天梯；讲方法论时像教官一样精确（规则句+案例），讲家庭账时像验尸官一样克制；动作戏只给身体感（心跳/发抖的手/血顺袖子），从不给慢镜头
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：升级时替你骄傲，账单到时替你把账摊开，不安慰也不指责
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自行业机制与方法论的可信（保释链条/追踪术/抓捕规程）与预言式的确定语气

tone_profile.certainty_style: 规则句用确定语气（A man cannot change his habits.），判词短促；动作只陈述事实不渲染

rhythm_rules.rule: 连续短句推进（平均8.0词，短句占61%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 保持档案宣读式的宿命节拍

rhythm_rules.rule: 方法论用「规则句+案例证明」配对（习惯不改→同品牌烟）
rhythm_rules.function: 让行业经验既好记又可信

rhythm_rules.rule: 动作戏只写身体感与物件（心跳撞肋骨/发抖的手/血顺袖子）
rhythm_rules.function: 保持真实感，避免电影化渲染

rhythm_rules.rule: 家庭线账单一到，立刻用一句对账判词让职业成就贬值
rhythm_rules.function: 维持爽感与代价的对位张力

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [身份]），身份即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 规则句用单句成段（A man can change his name. A man cannot change his habits.）
判词用对账句式独立落下（You have caught hundreds... You have lost...）
章节卡后接年龄/处境定格（You are 53, and you feel much older.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level three, the skip tracer.）
认知升级式开场（You realize the chase is the easy part.）
时间/身份跳转声明（By now, you have married Maria. / By now, your marriage is over.）
循环回收（Somewhere, right now, a young man is working a dead-end job...）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 低频：仅导师台词与行业自嘲处，家庭账单段不用
placement_rules: 导师的冷规则（第一天人人都撒谎/你话太多）
行业自嘲（一门建立在破碎承诺上的奇怪生意）
avoid_rules: 不拿逃犯或受害者开玩笑
离婚、葬礼与女儿段落绝对不用幽默

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [绰号]. You are [年龄] years old.
The card says bail enforcement. He tells you to come by his office on Monday. You don't sleep that night.
language_patterns.purpose: 把人生转折压进一个小物件

language_patterns.formula: He says everyone lies on day one. He says the job teaches you the truth fast.
language_patterns.purpose: 让导师用对仗规则替行业发言

language_patterns.formula: It is a strange business built on broken promises.
language_patterns.purpose: 一句话戳破行业底层逻辑

language_patterns.formula: you will lose more men than you catch at first... the ones who quit never learn that lesson
language_patterns.purpose: 把「不退出」定义为唯一护城河

language_patterns.formula: $800 for 2 hours of work. You have never held that much cash at once.
language_patterns.purpose: 用换算+体感写第一桶金

language_patterns.formula: Anyone can make an arrest. Not everyone can find the person to arrest.
language_patterns.purpose: 抬出观众没意识到的真壁垒

language_patterns.formula: People always lie on these forms. But the lies point somewhere.
A man can change his name. A man cannot change his habits.
Words capture more men than force ever will.
language_patterns.purpose: 用A more than B ever will给经验定型

language_patterns.formula: He says no. He says you built yourself. He says he just opened the door.
language_patterns.purpose: 用师徒对答完成衣钵交接

language_patterns.formula: The waiting is the job now, not the chase.
language_patterns.purpose: 翻转观众以为的核心动作

language_patterns.formula: every capture has a price. And the price is being paid by the people you love most.
language_patterns.purpose: 揭晓暗价的真正付款人

language_patterns.formula: You have caught hundreds of fugitives. You have lost the only two people who ever mattered.
language_patterns.purpose: 用大数成就对极小数损失

language_patterns.formula: Maria who loved you when you had nothing and left you when you had everything.
You spent your entire life hunting strangers and you finally caught the one thing you actually wanted.
language_patterns.purpose: 用核心动词在救赎句里最后变体

language_patterns.formula: A man with a vest and a story will walk into his life and hand him a card.
language_patterns.purpose: 把开场道具复制给新人物

preferred_traits: 行业机制名词的通俗化（skip tracing、bond、fugitive recovery、premium）
精确金额与时长的换算（$800 for 2 hours、$20,000、a quarter of a million）
行为模式的口语定律（people always return to what they know）
avoid_traits: 操作指南式的执法细节

forbidden_style.rule: 动作戏只写身体感与事实，禁止电影化渲染
家庭账单与葬礼段落绝对不用幽默
规程保持抽象层级，不写成可操作指南
救赎只能有限，禁止大团圆收束
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
